description: React frontend with Vite - drag & drop image upload, detection results display, and watermark removal with mode selection (fast/full). Clean modern UI.
steps: Initialize Vite React+TypeScript project in frontend/ directory: npm create vite@latest frontend -- --template react-ts. Install dependencies: axios, react-dropzone, lucide-react (icons), tailwindcss + postcss + autoprefixer for styling.
Configure Tailwind CSS: create tailwind.config.js and postcss.config.js, update index.css with Tailwind directives.

Create frontend/src/api/client.ts - API client module with functions: detectWatermark(file: File), removeWatermark(file: File, mode: 'fast'|'full', strength?: string), getJobStatus(jobId: string), getJobResult(jobId: string). Base URL configurable via env var VITE_API_URL (default http://localhost:8000).
Create frontend/src/components/ImageDropzone.tsx - Drag & drop zone component using react-dropzone. Shows preview of dropped image. Accepts PNG/JPG/WebP. Displays file name and size after drop.

Create frontend/src/components/DetectionResult.tsx - Displays detection results: watermark status (colored badge), confidence score (progress bar), phase match, detailed metrics in collapsible section.

Create frontend/src/components/RemovalPanel.tsx - Mode selector (fast/full radio buttons with descriptions: fast = 'Spectral subtraction, PSNR 43dB+, seconds', full = '7-stage pipeline, maximum removal, slower'). Strength selector. Remove button. Shows progress/status during processing. Displays before/after comparison when done.
Create frontend/src/components/ImageComparison.tsx - Side-by-side or slider comparison of original vs cleaned image. Shows PSNR and stages applied.

Create frontend/src/App.tsx - Main app layout: header with tool name, main content area with ImageDropzone, action buttons (Detect / Remove), results panels. State management with useState/useReducer for: uploaded file, detection result, removal result, processing status, selected mode.
Create frontend/src/components/Header.tsx - Simple header with app title 'SynthID Tool' and brief description.
Configure Vite proxy in vite.config.ts: proxy /api requests to http://localhost:8000 during development.
Add npm scripts in package.json: dev (vite), build (vite build), preview (vite preview).
acceptance_criteria: cd frontend && npm install completes without errors
cd frontend && npm run build produces a dist/ directory with index.html
The UI has a drag-and-drop zone for image upload
The UI has Detect and Remove buttons with mode selection (fast/full)
The UI displays detection results (watermarked status, confidence) after detection
The UI displays before/after image comparison after removal
Vite dev server proxy is configured to forward /api to backend
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/reverse-synthid-tool/frontend && npm install && npm run build
findings: Node.js was not pre-installed; installed nodejs 20.x from nodesource. Used Tailwind CSS v4 with @tailwindcss/vite plugin (CSS-based config via @import 'tailwindcss' instead of v3 tailwind.config.js). Build produces dist/ with ~18KB CSS and ~311KB JS bundle.
